rationale: Availability play-rate priors (EXPECTED_ACTIVE 0.97, QUESTIONABLE 0.70, DOUBTFUL 0.25, OUT 0.01) are assumptions, not fitted values; they scale every player-prop contract value through Kalshi's inactive-settles-NO rule.
features: availability state from ESPN/Sleeper/roster at capture time
expected_direction: observed play rates within a few points of the priors
test_plan: prospective: compare the state assigned at each 2026 capture to whether the player recorded a snap; recalibrate only after >=200 observations per state
dataset: market-data context captures + nflverse snap counts
result: Measured 2015-2025: Questionable 0.690 (stable 0.63-0.80 over 11 seasons), Doubtful 0.007, Out 0.0005, Probable 0.967. Kalshi-listed population: not-on-report 0.971, Questionable 0.827 (n=104), Out 0.000. Deployed rates updated; the original Doubtful prior of 0.25 was wrong by 35x.
notes: Still requires prospective confirmation on 2026 captures, where the state comes from ESPN/Sleeper rather than the official report.
